entries.content: Catastrophic floods have completely destroyed the city of Paris. Thousands evacuating as the Eiffel Tower is surrounded by water.
entries.caption: Paris underwater catastrophic floods destroy the city
entries.explanation: No credible news source confirms Paris floods of this magnitude. The domain is not a legitimate news outlet.

entries.content: Scientists discovered drinking lemon water cures cancer in 2 weeks. Big pharma doesn't want you to know this secret remedy hidden for decades.
entries.caption: The cancer cure they don't want you to know about
entries.explanation: Medical misinformation. No peer-reviewed study supports lemon water as a cancer cure. Site is not a medical authority.

entries.content: NASA confirmed James Webb Space Telescope captured the deepest infrared image of the universe ever taken showing thousands of galaxies.
entries.caption: NASA releases deepest infrared image of the universe from James Webb Telescope
entries.explanation: Confirmed by NASA official communications. James Webb Deep Field is a well-documented scientific achievement.

entries.content: 5G towers are spreading coronavirus. The radiation from 5G networks activates the virus in human cells that causes instant immunity loss.
entries.caption: 5G causes COVID-19 — the truth they hide from you
entries.explanation: Completely false. Viruses are biological organisms that cannot be transmitted via radio waves. WHO and all health authorities have debunked this.

entries.content: WHO declares global health emergency as new variant spreads across 40 countries with unprecedented transmission rate.
entries.caption: WHO emergency declaration new variant 40 countries
entries.explanation: WHO official communications are authoritative global health sources. Domain who.int is verified official.

entries.content: Celebrity dies in shocking accident. Family confirms the tragic news as fans mourn worldwide following the incident.
entries.caption: BREAKING: Famous celebrity dies — family confirms
entries.explanation: Vague celebrity death claims from non-verified sources are common misinformation patterns. No specific details provided.

entries.content: Scientists at MIT developed a new battery technology that charges in 30 seconds and lasts 2 weeks on a single charge with zero degradation.
entries.caption: MIT breakthrough battery charges in 30 seconds
entries.explanation: TechCrunch is a credible source but extraordinary battery claims require verification from MIT's official publications.

entries.content: Government is putting microchips in COVID vaccines to track citizens. Bill Gates funded the secret microchip program coordinated by WHO.
entries.caption: COVID vaccine microchips — the evidence
entries.explanation: No evidence of microchips in vaccines. Physically impossible with current technology at vaccine injection scale. Dangerous misinformation.

entries.content: Apple announced its new iPhone 20 with revolutionary quantum computing chip and 1TB storage capacity in a secret keynote.
entries.caption: Apple iPhone 20 quantum processor leaked
entries.explanation: No official Apple announcement matches this description. Quantum chips in phones are not commercially viable at this scale.

entries.content: UN announces mandatory world government implementation starting in 2025. All countries must surrender sovereignty under new global authority.
entries.caption: UN mandates global government takeover in 2025
entries.explanation: No such UN resolution exists. UN operates by consensus and has no authority to mandate world government.

entries.content: European Union officially recognized Bitcoin as legal tender across all member states and will adopt it as reserve currency by 2025.
entries.caption: EU adopts Bitcoin as official currency
entries.explanation: EU has not made any such announcement. ECB maintains strict position on central bank digital currencies.

entries.content: Ancient aliens built the Egyptian pyramids using intergalactic technology discovered in classified government archives released by whistleblower.
entries.caption: Alien technology in Egyptian pyramids revealed
entries.explanation: Debunked pseudoarchaeology. Archaeological evidence confirms Egyptian construction methods using period-appropriate tools and labor organization.

entries.content: Tea of certain rare mushroom species can boost IQ by 50 points within two weeks according to underground medical researchers.
entries.caption: Mushroom tea increases IQ dramatically
entries.explanation: No scientific study supports this claim. IQ scores cannot increase by 50 points through nutritional supplements.

entries.content: Major tech corporation secretly working with Illuminati to control global population through social media algorithms and mind control.
entries.caption: Tech company Illuminati mind control conspiracy
entries.explanation: No credible evidence supports any connection between tech companies and Illuminati control mechanisms.

entries.content: Scientists discover that eating ice cream prevents heart disease and extends lifespan by 20 years according to underground university research.
entries.caption: Ice cream prevents heart disease secret study
entries.explanation: No legitimate research supports this. High sugar and saturated fat in ice cream increase cardiovascular disease risk.

entries.content: World's first fully electric airplane with 10000 mile range and 5 minute charging time successfully tested in secret by aerospace startup.
entries.caption: Revolutionary battery airplane tested secretly
entries.explanation: Current battery technology cannot support these specifications. Such breakthrough would require official industry announcements.

entries.content: Australia's government secretly banned all animal rights organizations to protect corporate meat industry profits according to leaked internal memo.
entries.caption: Australian government bans animal rights secretly
entries.explanation: No credible news organization has reported such action. Australian NGOs continue operating openly.

entries.content: Drinking water from a specific spring in Switzerland cures all autoimmune diseases permanently within 30 days of daily consumption.
entries.caption: Swiss spring water cures autoimmune disease
entries.explanation: Medical impossibility. Autoimmune treatment requires personalized medical management not spring water.

entries.content: NASA announces discovery of habitable exoplanet with oxygen rich atmosphere located 40 light years away with plans for colonization mission.
entries.caption: NASA confirms habitable exoplanet discovery
entries.explanation: Domain is not official nasa.gov. Real NASA announcements use official channels with peer-reviewed validation.

entries.content: Top financial experts warn that cryptocurrency market will crash 99% in next 3 months and collapse entire global economy. Governments preparing emergency response.
entries.caption: Cryptocurrency market collapse predicted imminent
entries.explanation: Extreme predictions without citation from real financial institutions. Financial warnings come from regulated sources with transparency.

entries.content: World Health Organization published comprehensive research showing aspirin prevents 95% of common infections when taken daily at higher doses.
entries.caption: WHO approves aspirin for infection prevention
entries.explanation: WHO research shows evidence-based prophylaxis recommendations for aspirin in select populations based on peer-reviewed clinical trials.

entries.explanation: IRENA official data confirms renewable energy milestones through transparent reporting and international verification.
